name: Hermes Agent
author: grandpaacademy
description: Self-hosted AI agent by Nous Research. Includes OpenAI-compatible gateway API (port 8642), web dashboard (port 9119), persistent memory, skills, and multi-profile support. Requires at least one LLM provider API key.

scripts.install:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grandpaacademy/eggs/main/ai/hermes-agent/startup.sh -o /home/container/startup.sh 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x /home/container/startup.sh 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /home/container/{sessions,memories,skills,home,cron,hooks,logs,skins,config}
mkdir -p /home/container/logs/gateways/default
echo "[hermes] Install complete"

variables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
variables.description: OpenRouter API key for LLM access.

variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
variables.description: Anthropic API key for Claude models.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: OpenAI API key for GPT models.

variables.name: HERMES_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD
variables.description: Dashboard login password. Generated per-instance by the panel at creation; change it here any time.

variables.name: API_SERVER_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable OpenAI-compatible API server on port 8642
